title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: What you watch
hook: During a game, what are you actually watching?
intro: The real lesson is happening away from it.
statement: What you watch decides what you can coach.
q1: Do you watch players away from the ball —
q2: or follow the ball and the score?
q3: What did you miss last game?
t1: There is no single right way. But you coach better
t2: when you watch more than the ball.
ctaLines: Spacing. Effort off the ball. Body language.
ctaPrompt: Share your game habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
During a game, what are you actually watching?
Most eyes follow the ball. The real lesson is happening away from it.
What you watch decides what you can coach.
Watch the players or follow the ball. Every team is different.
What do you watch? Share your habit in the comments.
